'''June 2000 Tampa tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Tampa, FL on 19 June 2000. [[Neal Razi]] won it. It is known from Neal Razi's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d914">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-19-dredlox-s-anthology-in-tampa-6-19-00d914/ dredlox-s-anthology-in-tampa-6-19-00], DeckTech (Neal "Dredlox" Razi, 19 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-19-dredlox-s-anthology-in-tampa-6-19-00d914/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 19 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Tampa, FL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Neal Razi]]
